## Planned

Papers and talks will appear here as they come out.

::: {.audience-table}
| For whom | What |
|----|----|
| Philosophers | Two articles in philosophy of science; a symposium at the Philosophy of Science Association |
| STS scholars | One article in science and technology studies (STS); a symposium at the Society for Social Studies of Science |
| Climate scientists | A perspective piece |
| General readers | A public-facing article |
| Everyone | A report or proceedings from the [workshop](workshop.qmd) |
:::
